app.name: ISLAM 307
policy: AI never invents Quran, Hadith, or Tafsir — it only searches local authenticated databases.
No copyrighted datasets are used without permission.

sources.title: Tanzil Quran Text (Uthmani)
sources.purpose: Offline Arabic Quran text for reading, search, copy, bookmark, and AI reference.
sources.attribution: Quran text courtesy of Tanzil Project (https://tanzil.net). The text is used unmodified (NoDerivatives).
sources.notes: BY-ND requires attribution and forbids derivative changes to the Quran text.

sources.title: Quranic Arabic Corpus — Morphology
sources.purpose: Word-by-word morphology, grammar tags, roots, lemmas, and syntax segments for offline word study.
sources.license: GNU General Public License (GPL) with Quranic Arabic Corpus terms of use
sources.attribution: Morphological annotation © Kais Dukes, Quranic Arabic Corpus (http://corpus.quran.com). Annotations are used without alteration.
sources.notes: Applications may use the corpus data with attribution and a link to corpus.quran.com. Do not change annotations.

sources.title: Quran.com word glosses (EN / UR)
sources.purpose: English and Urdu word meanings and transliteration bundled offline for word-by-word study.
sources.license: Quran.com / QuranFoundation terms — attribution required; commercial redistribution may require permission
sources.attribution: Word translations and transliteration via Quran.com API (https://quran.com). Used for a free Sadaqah Jariyah offline app with attribution.
sources.notes: If redistributing commercially, contact QuranFoundation for clarification.

sources.title: Quran.com metadata
sources.purpose: Surah metadata, page/juz/ruku/sajdah mapping, and related structural fields.
sources.attribution: Structural Quran metadata from Quran.com API v4 (https://quran.com).

sources.title: Sahih International (English translation)
sources.purpose: English ayah translation for offline reading and search.
sources.license: Widely redistributed for free Islamic education; preserve attribution

sources.title: Maulana Muhammad Junagarhi (Urdu translation)
sources.purpose: Urdu ayah translation for offline reading and search.
sources.license: Distributed via Quran.com translation resources; preserve attribution
sources.attribution: Urdu translation: Maulana Muhammad Junagarhi (Quran.com translation id 54).

sources.title: EveryAyah recitation audio
sources.purpose: Optional network Quran recitation playback (not stored per-word).
sources.attribution: Recitation audio streams from EveryAyah.com when the user chooses to play a reciter.
sources.notes: Word/verse TTS uses the device offline Text-To-Speech engine — audio files are not stored for every word.

sources.title: Hadith collections (offline packs)
sources.purpose: Bukhari, Muslim, Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi text for offline reading and AI source search.
sources.license: See verification reports; preserve book/number grading attribution
sources.attribution: Hadith text and metadata are served only from authenticated local hadith.db packs. AI must cite book and number.
sources.notes: Commercial readiness depends on verified provenance documented under reports/verification/.

sources.title: Tafsir packs (offline)
sources.purpose: Authenticated tafsir text for offline reading and AI source search.
sources.license: Per-pack license; preserve source name and reference
sources.attribution: Tafsir entries come only from local tafsir.db. Unavailable packs show an explicit unavailable message — never invented text.
